neighbours.label: The token ' born' (was born, born in, a born leader), not other life-event verbs (raised, died, grew up) and not 'borne'
fire: The composer Edvard Grieg was born in Bergen in 1843.
Our second son was born during a snowstorm in February.
She seemed born to perform, singing before she could walk.
Records show that Ada was born in London on 10 December.
Twin foals were born on the farm last spring.
He was a born storyteller who could hold any room.
The novelist was born in a small village near Kraków.
Most of the colony's settlers had been born in England.

The novelist grew up in a small village near Kraków.
